description: One public event by slug: its summary (name, kind, status, dates) and the standings board — each member's rank, Riot ID, region, current tier/division/LP, persona and team tag, done/failed flags, and the kind-specific `progress` payload (LP gained for a race, challenge counters, …). `peak: true` shows the board as a record (best standings, hidden members re-admitted) instead of live. Unknown slug → an error; find slugs with `list_events` or `search`.

slug.description: The event slug from a trackdiff.com/events/<slug> URL.

name: get_event_standings
title: Event standings
